basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Geomagnetism (IIG), Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, has invited applications for 8 posts in 8 roles under Advt No. 06/IIG/HRD/2026. The posts include Assistant Professor Grade-I, Assistant Professor Grade-II, Assistant Professor Grade-II (Geophysics), Junior Superintendent and 4 more. The online application is open from 16 October 2026 to 10 November 2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIG Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 10 November 2026. Applications opened on 16 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in IIG Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 8 vacancies: 1 Assistant Professor Grade-I, 1 Assistant Professor Grade-II, 1 Assistant Professor Grade-II (Geophysics), 1 Junior Superintendent, 1 Stenographer Grade-I, 1 Technical Assistant (Electronics) and 2 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for IIG Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 10 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Unreserved/ OBC/ EWS / others (Assistant Professor Grade-I & II): Rs. 1200. Female /SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-servicemen (Assistant Professor Grade-I & II): Rs. 1000. Unreserved/ OBC/ EWS / others (Other Posts): Rs. 900. Female /SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-servicemen (Other Posts): Rs. 700.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Assistant Professor Grade-I: maximum 40 years; Assistant Professor Grade-II: maximum 35 years; Assistant Professor Grade-II (Geophysics): maximum 35 years; Junior Superintendent: maximum 32 years; Stenographer Grade-I: maximum 56 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Level 11 (Rs. 67,700 – 2,08,700 ) for Assistant Professor Grade-I, Level 10 (Rs. 56,100 – 1,77,500 ) for Assistant Professor Grade-II, Level 10 (Rs. 56,100 – 1,77,500 ) for Assistant Professor Grade-II (Geophysics), Level 06 (Rs. 35,400 – 1,12,400 ) for Junior Superintendent, Level 06 (Rs. 35,400 – 1,12,400 ) for Stenographer Grade-I.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Master's Degree or Bachelor's Degree or Diploma or Doctorate in relevant discipline with required experience as per post. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates must possess benchmark disability of not less than 40% for PwBD category. Typing speed of 35 wpm in English or 30 wpm in Hindi for Senior Administrative Assistant. No traveling allowance will be paid for attending tests or interviews.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Screening of applications. Written test / Skill test / Trade test / Interview. Document verification. Screening test.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The period of deputation for Stenographer Grade-I shall be 03 years.
